_meta.description: Knowledge base for SHAP explanation generation.
_meta.severity_scale: Heuristic ordinal scale 1-5 (5=highest risk). Values reflect expert judgment on credential theft / deception severity. Not empirically calibrated; presented as a proposed weighting scheme.
_meta.keyword_matching_note: Keywords are matched case-insensitively on email body text. Some keywords (e.g. 'act', 'now', 'today', 'important') are intentionally broad to maximise recall. False positives on legitimate emails are expected; the system relies on SHAP feature weights to filter noise. This is a heuristic pseudo-label scheme (weakly supervised); keywords are not human-validated ground truth.
_meta.changelog_2_1: 2.1: Removed feature names (url_like_count, has_attachment) from keyword lists. Removed duplicate 'invoice' from Attachment. Added Fear/Threat Language concept. Moved suspended/locked from Urgency to Fear. Fixed 'bit'+'ly' to 'bit.ly'+'bitly'. Improved vague NLP explanations. Added spam_malicious summary template. Updated confidence_templates low. Documented severity scale.

concepts.name: Urgency / Pressure Language
concepts.description: Uses urgency or pressure to encourage quick decisions without careful thinking.

concepts.name: Suspicious Links
concepts.description: Contains or refers to web links that may redirect users to fraudulent websites.

concepts.name: Credential Request
concepts.description: Requests login credentials or account verification.

concepts.name: Financial Incentive
concepts.description: Mentions money, rewards, invoices, or financial transactions.

concepts.name: Authority Impersonation
concepts.description: Appears to come from an organization or trusted authority.

concepts.name: Generic Greeting
concepts.description: Uses generic greetings instead of addressing the recipient personally.

concepts.name: Fear / Threat Language
concepts.description: Uses fear or threat of consequences to pressure the recipient into acting.

word_count.increases_risk: The overall length of this email contributed to a higher phishing score because it resembled patterns commonly seen in phishing emails.
word_count.decreases_risk: The email length was more similar to legitimate emails, reducing the phishing score.

avg_word_length.increases_risk: Unusually short or long average word length increased the phishing score. Phishing emails often use very short words for urgency or unusually long technical-sounding words to appear authoritative.
avg_word_length.decreases_risk: The writing style appeared similar to legitimate emails, reducing the phishing score.

uppercase_ratio.increases_risk: The use of capital letters increased the phishing score because phishing emails often use capitalization to attract attention.
uppercase_ratio.decreases_risk: The capitalization pattern resembled legitimate emails, reducing the phishing score.

url_like_count.increases_risk: Links or web addresses increased the phishing score because phishing emails frequently direct users to external websites.
url_like_count.decreases_risk: Very few suspicious links contributed to the phishing score.

text_entropy.increases_risk: The writing pattern differed from typical legitimate emails, increasing the phishing score.
text_entropy.decreases_risk: The writing pattern appeared similar to normal email communication, reducing the phishing score.

action_density.increases_risk: Action-oriented language increased the phishing score because phishing emails often encourage immediate action.
action_density.decreases_risk: The writing style appeared less aggressive than emails typically classified as phishing.

has_attachment.increases_risk: The attachment increased the phishing score because attachments are commonly used to distribute malicious files.
has_attachment.decreases_risk: Attachments did not contribute to the phishing score.

repeated_char_patterns.increases_risk: Unusual repeated characters increased the phishing score because they are commonly seen in spam or phishing emails.
repeated_char_patterns.decreases_risk: The writing did not contain unusual repeated-character patterns, reducing the phishing score.

writing_error_total.increases_risk: The number of spelling and grammar errors increased the phishing score. Phishing emails frequently contain writing errors due to automated generation or non-native authorship.
writing_error_total.decreases_risk: The writing quality appeared similar to professionally written emails, reducing the phishing score.

tfidf_templates.increase: The word '{feature}' increased the phishing score because it is commonly associated with phishing emails.
tfidf_templates.decrease: The word '{feature}' reduced the phishing score because it is more commonly found in legitimate emails.

confidence_templates.high: Both machine learning models independently identified multiple phishing indicators, making this prediction highly reliable.
confidence_templates.medium: Most important phishing indicators were identified consistently by both models.
confidence_templates.low: The models show limited agreement on key indicators, or explanation consistency (Sx) is low. This prediction should be interpreted with caution.

summary_templates.phishing: This email exhibits several characteristics commonly associated with phishing attacks.
summary_templates.legitimate: The email resembles normal legitimate communication and contains very few phishing indicators.
summary_templates.spam_malicious: This email exhibits several characteristics commonly associated with spam or malicious email campaigns.

counterfactual_templates.default: If this email did not contain {items}, it would likely receive a much lower phishing score.
counterfactual_templates.legitimate: If additional suspicious indicators such as {items} were present, the email would likely be classified as phishing.

risk_messages.VERY HIGH: Immediate caution is recommended. The email contains strong phishing characteristics.
risk_messages.HIGH: The email appears highly suspicious and should be treated carefully.
risk_messages.MEDIUM: Some phishing indicators were detected. Verify before taking any action.
risk_messages.LOW: Very few phishing indicators were detected.

concept_phrases.Credential Request: a request to verify or re-enter account credentials
concept_phrases.Fear / Threat Language: threatening language implying account suspension or security breach
